verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, that mendicant said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena m’idhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṁ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, what is the cause, what is the reason why some spontaneously-born dragons keep the sabbath, having transformed their bodies?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bhikkhu, ekaccānaṁ opapātikānaṁ nāgānaṁ evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “Mendicant, it’s when some spontaneously-born dragons think:

verses.pali: ‘mayaṁ kho pubbe kāyena dvayakārino ahumha, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino.
verses.english: ‘In the past we did both kinds of deeds by body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Te mayaṁ kāyena dvayakārino, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā opapātikānaṁ nāgānaṁ sahabyataṁ upapannā.
verses.english: When the body broke up, after death, we were reborn in the company of the spontaneously-born dragons.

verses.pali: Sacajja mayaṁ kāyena sucaritaṁ careyyāma, vācāya … manasā sucaritaṁ careyyāma, evaṁ mayaṁ kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjeyyāma.
verses.english: If today we do good things by body, speech, and mind, when the body breaks up, after death, we may be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Handa mayaṁ etarahi kāyena sucaritaṁ carāma, vācāya … manasā sucaritaṁ carāmā’ti.
verses.english: Come, let us do good things by way of body, speech, and mind.’

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yena m’idhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṁ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why some spontaneously-born dragons keep the sabbath, having transformed their bodies.”
